messages:
violet: FYI — staging p99 jumped from ~380ms to ~1.2s after onboarding model v2.3.0 (new tokenizer + checkpoint). profiler + a couple traces below, noticed lots of small KV cache misses and a weird kernel selection flip. :eyes:

sam: ugh. did CI catch this?

perf-bot: CI perf-check failed on master at commit 0a9f2b — p99 regression +320ms for model-family/xl. See /ci/artifacts/0a9f2b/perf-report.html

jin: thanks. starting a bisect on the release batch that landed the tokenizer change (PR #4123). quick question — is this appearing only on long-context requests or across the board?

violet: appears mostly on short->medium sequences (len 16-128). tracer shows repeated kernel re-selection every few tokens: switching between `attn_fast` and `attn_generic` which causes overhead. also KV cache shows a lot of evictions due to slightly different key shape after tokenizer change. snippet: ```
[2026-03-18T09:12:41Z] kernel_select: attn_fast -> attn_generic (reason: shape-mismatch)
[2026-03-18T09:12:41Z] kvcache: miss key=tokmap_v2 len=48
[2026-03-18T09:12:41Z] scheduler: flush small batch scheduled (size=2)
```

maya: that smells like tokenizer produced different tokenization for the same prompt prefix so caching and batching heuristics get confused. did the tokenizer config bump change `add_bos` or `pad_side`?

alec: confirmed: model v2.3.0 tokenizer has `use_fast=false` in the onboard config (PR accidentally flipped it). That changed token lengths slightly and also the token id dtype path used in kernel selector. Here's the diff I pulled from the onboard manifest: ```
- tokenizer: { use_fast: true, normalize: "nfkc" }
+ tokenizer: { use_fast: false, normalize: "nfkc" }
```

sam: can we hotfix by pinning kernel selector for this model-family until we get a proper fix? e.g. set `model.runtime.kernel_selector.force=attn_generic` in staging config?

jin: quick experiment: forcing `attn_generic` removes the flip but p50 rises slightly, p99 drops back to baseline. running a small perf sweep now. command I ran: ```
./infra/ops/set-model-config --model model-family/xl --key runtime.kernel_selector.force --value attn_generic --env staging
```

violet: copy. if it stabilizes staging we should pause rollout of v2.3.0 to prod and open a revert PR for the tokenizer change.

alec: alternative quicker patch: make kernel selector compare tokenization shape using normalized-length rather than raw-dtype path to avoid misroute when `use_fast` flips. small code diff prepared, unit tests added. perf impact looks ok on local bench: ```
before p99=1.18s after p99=0.39s (baseline 0.38s)
```

maya: +1 to guarding selector, but we should also add a model-onboard check that warns if tokenizer attrs changed vs previous version (fail fast on config drift).

sam: agree — pause rollout, apply `attn_generic` pin for now, and merge alec's selector-guard on canary. I'll open the pause + pin PR and the revert PR for tokenizer change.

perf-bot: staging config change deployed by sam at 2401234679 — pinned kernel to attn_generic for model-family/xl

violet: after pin, observed p99 drop to 400ms within 4 minutes. leaving monitoring on for 30m before marking rollout paused. thanks all. :thumbsup:

jin: bisect result: root cause = tokenizer config flip in PR #4123 (merged with missing changelog). marking as rollout-blocker and adding detection to onboard pipeline.

maya: filing follow-up to add onboarding gate: compare tokenization sample hashes + distribution histogram to previous version; if delta > threshold block rollout automatically.

alec: I'll open the PR for kernel selector guard and add perf regression test to CI for this model family.

sam: nice work — retrospective action items: (1) onboarding validator for tokenizer attrs, (2) kernel-selector fallback guard, (3) make canary pause automatic on 2x p99 regression.

violet: logging action items to the incident doc. thanks team.
